"That's How We Do It In Delhi ?" - Hit Machine Badshah collaborates with multi talented hip hop artist from Delhi - Fotty Seven on this super fun , super crazy song - Boht Tej. "Boht Tej" is all about the vibes , culture and slangs of Delhi. This is first from the lot of Kaleshi Launde
Song Name : Boht Tej
Artist : Fotty Seven ft Badshah
Lyrics : Fotty Seven & Badshah
Music : Fotty Seven
Mix : Fotty Seven
Master : Camilo Silva
Video : Akhil Sachdeva
